description: Local WEB-14a merge of accepted WEB-10a b9fd602f. IDs on accepted main remain unchanged. The 24 colliding WEB-14a entries move by +1000; their patches and expected tests are unchanged. Historical evidence and approval plans retain their original IDs and candidate identity; apply this explicit mapping to future WEB-14a selections, never reinterpret old results as covering main entries. The accepted WEB-08d merge of 27 October 2026 also moves seven colliding WEB-14a UNIT IDs 1701–1707 to 3701–3707; accepted-main IDs and historical evidence stay unchanged. WEB-14a/WEB-11a integration 2 November 2026: no additional within-layer ID collisions; both parent entries retained, old evidence keeps original identity. WEB-14a maintenance merge of accepted main 74b0baca (WEB-10c, accepted at 3f8fdf94, and WEB-19), 6 November 2026: WEB-10c took MU-3001..MU-3368, so the 24 WEB-14a UNIT entries already at MU-3001..MU-3024 move again, by +1000, to MU-4001..MU-4024 (a second hop of the 25 October mapping: MU-2001..MU-2024 to MU-3001..MU-3024 to MU-4001..MU-4024); accepted-main IDs and historical evidence stay unchanged.
